text: いせき　かと　おもって　はいったら　ゴーストだらけ　じゃないか！

structure.jp: いせき　かと　おもって
ゴーストだらけ　じゃないか！
structure.en: it's full of Ghost Pokémon, isn't it!

patterns.name: 〜かとおもう
patterns.span: いせき　かと　おもって
patterns.explanation: かとおもう says you guessed something might be so, without being sure. いせき　かと　おもって = 'thinking it was probably ruins'.

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら here means 'when I did that, I found...', leading into a surprise. はいったら = 'when I went in'.

patterns.name: 〜だらけ
patterns.explanation: だらけ after a thing means a place is covered or filled with it, in an unwelcome way. ゴーストだらけ = 'crawling with Ghost Pokémon'.
